verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state that once an embedder is configured, Meilisearch auto-generates vector embeddings for documents and handles semantic/hybrid search without the developer computing embeddings themselves, and this applies to both indexing and querying. Missing for 10: no explicit list/detail of supported managed embedder providers (OpenAI, HuggingFace, etc.) or hands-on/community confirmation of the embedder setup working in practice.
